rationale: Karsin brings deep expertise in database systems and distributed query optimization from Oracle, while Sanjay is designing data annotation workflows at Skan AI—a complementary pairing where database-scale thinking could inform product decisions around handling large annotated datasets. Both are based in San Francisco and their skill sets are mutually reinforcing: Karsin's database architecture knowledge and Sanjay's product design and React expertise could unlock better tooling for data-intensive products.
intro_message: Karsin Kamakotti, meet Sanjay — you're both in San Francisco working on data-heavy systems from different angles (database optimization vs. annotation tooling), and your technical backgrounds complement each other well.
